articles.title: IIT Gandhinagar's PG Diploma in AI -ML & Agentic AI Engineering to Begin New Cohort in ...
articles.content: Gandhinagar (Gujarat) [India], August 31: At 8:30 in the morning , on a 400-acre campus where the Sabarmati curves past IIT Gandhinagar’s hostels, a group of students gathers for what the program calls Squad Sync. By 7:30 that evening , after faculty lectures, build sessions, and a nightly competitive-coding hour, most of them are still at their laptops. This is the Residential PG Diploma in AI-ML & Agentic AI Engineering , and it is the first postgraduate AI program in the country delivered entirely on an IIT campus rather than through an online format. The program’s next cohort has its curriculum curated around a specific goal: training students for Forward Deployed Engineering , a role built around embedding inside a client’s organisation and shipping working agentic AI systems into their actual environment, rather than handing over a model and a report. “Our engagements with industry leaders clearly indicated to us that they are increasingly pivoting to the FDE role,” said Prof. Sam Placid, CEO, Competency Advancement Academy (CAA), IIT Gandhinagar . “In keeping with our stated objective of aligning our curriculum with industry needs, we have tweaked our curriculum to address this requirement.” Two years ago, Forward Deployed Engineer barely existed as a job title. It’s now one of the fastest-growing and highest-paid categories in AI hiring. US postings are up 729% year-on-year , and salaries at companies like OpenAI, Anthropic and Google are reaching past $400,000 . The program itself remains unusual by Indian standards. It’s delivered fully residentially on IIT Gandhinagar’s campus , as opposed to the online, weekend-format programs that carry an IIT name elsewhere. Entry is through AINPT, a 120-minute proprietary exam followed by a panel interview , not JEE or GATE. Seats are limited. No shortcuts ; the admissions material says so more than once. Graduates leave with a PG Diploma from IIT Gandhinagar and Alumni status , along with 15 to 20 deployed projects built during the program, rather than classroom assignments. The new cohort begins in September 2026 . About the program: The Residential PG Diploma in AI-ML & Agentic AI Engineering is offered by IIT Gandhinagar through the Competency Advancement Academy (CAA). articles.title: BULLET Microdrama unveils 'The Dwarka Project' trailer - Indian Broadcasting World
articles.content: New Delhi, 31-Aug-2026, By IBW Team BULLET Microdrama has unveiled the trailer of ‘The Dwarka Project’, an original Indian sci-fi anime film created entirely using Trinetra AI, its India-developed AI filmmaking platform. According to a BULLET Microdrama press release from Mumbai today, the trailer was launched at Anime India on August 31. The 100-minute film is described as India’s first AI-led anime film and is the first content project created entirely on Trinetra AI. Set in 2166, ‘The Dwarka Project’ follows Parth, a young man from the Marshland who enters the mainland in search of his abducted father. During his journey, he discovers extraordinary powers linked to the underwater city of Dwarka. Parth is then pulled into a dangerous conflict involving social divisions, advanced technology and a powerful corporation seeking to control the future. He also finds an unlikely ally in his mysterious roommate Vicky. The film combines an original Indian science-fiction story with anime-style storytelling and explores themes such as technology, social differences, identity, belonging and power. Azim Lalani, Co-Founder and Chief Business Officer of BULLET Microdrama, said the project aims to explore how AI can help filmmakers create original stories and feature films while working beyond some of the traditional limitations of filmmaking. The trailer was exclusively screened at Anime India, with the launch hosted by RJ Dheeraj.Backed by ZEE Entertainment Enterprises, ‘The Dwarka Project’ marks BULLET Microdrama’s first content project created entirely using Trinetra AI.

articles.title: BULLET Microdrama unveils trailer of The Dwarka Project - Adgully.com
articles.content: BULLET Microdrama, backed by ZEE Entertainment Enterprises Ltd. ('Z'), today unveiled the trailer of The Dwarka Project, an original Indian sci-fi anime feature film and India’s first AI-led anime film, at Anime India. The 100-minute feature is the first content project created entirely on Trinetra AI, BULLET’s India-developed AI filmmaking platform designed to help creators develop and produce original stories through an AI-led filmmaking process. Set in 2166, The Dwarka Project follows Parth, a young man from the Marshland who enters the mainland in search of his abducted father. After discovering extraordinary powers linked to the underwater city of Dwarka, Parth is drawn into a dangerous conflict involving social divisions, advanced technology and a powerful corporation seeking to control the future. As he struggles to understand and control his abilities, he finds an unlikely ally in his mysterious roommate Vicky, voiced by actor, who helps guide him through the battle ahead. The film brings an original Indian science-fiction narrative to anime through a feature-length format, allowing the story to explore a richly imagined future shaped by advanced technology, social divides and questions of identity, belonging and power. Commenting on the trailer launch, Azim Lalani, Co-Founder & Chief Business Officer, BULLET Microdrama, said, “The Dwarka Project is an experiment in what becomes possible when filmmaking is approached without some of the conventional constraints of production. We wanted to build an original Indian sci-fi and explore whether AI could enable us to take that vision from concept to a feature film. The fact that the entire film is being created on Trinetra AI makes this particularly significant for us, not simply as a technology demonstration, but as a test of a new production model. articles.title: URBAN ARC NOTE Price in India, Launch Date and Features: India's First AI Meeting Smart Band
articles.content: The URBAN ARC NOTE has launched in India with an interesting feature that makes it different from a regular fitness band. Along with tracking health and fitness, the band can record meetings, convert conversations into text and create AI summaries . The URBAN ARC NOTE price in India is ₹6,999 . Sales will begin from 7 September 2026 , while advance bookings start from 31 August 2026 at an effective price of ₹5,999 . Most fitness bands are mainly used for tracking steps, workouts and sleep. The ARC NOTE goes a step further by helping users keep track of important conversations and meetings. It is also a screen-free smart band , which means there is no display. All the recorded information, health data and other details can be accessed through the companion app. The band is mainly designed for professionals, students and anyone who regularly attends meetings, classes or conversations where taking notes may not always be convenient. The biggest highlight of the ARC NOTE is its built-in AI Meeting Recorder . URBAN ARC NOTE with ai meeting recorder Recording can be started by double-clicking the band, while a single press stops the recording. An indicator light turns on when audio is being recorded, making it clear when the recording feature is active. The band can provide close to 16 hours of recording time on a full charge. After recording a meeting or conversation, the ARC NOTE app processes the audio and provides several useful AI-powered features. Feature What It Does AI Transcription Converts recorded conversations into searchable text Live Translation Supports conversations across 17 or more Indian languages Minutes of Meeting Creates a short summary covering important points and decisions Auto Mind Map Organises discussion topics into a visual mind map for easier understanding These features can be useful for office meetings, interviews, lectures, client discussions and other situations where remembering every detail can be difficult. Health and Fitness Tracking on ARC NOTE The ARC NOTE is not only about recording meetings. It also offers the regular health and fitness features expected from a modern smart band. It supports 24×7 heart rate monitoring , SpO2 tracking, sleep monitoring and stress tracking . URBAN has also included AI Health Insights , which analyses health information and helps users understand different patterns in their daily activity and wellness data. For fitness tracking, the band comes with 110+ sports modes . There are six sensors built into the device for monitoring different health and activity parameters. The ARC NOTE also comes with IPX68 water resistance , which means it should comfortably handle sweat, rain and normal everyday splashes. articles.title: India launches first AI -powered safety platform, 'Agni Kawach', to build global industrial ...
articles.content: Agnikawach Safety Solutions Pvt. Ltd. today announced the launch of Agnikawach™, India’s first indigenous AI-integrated process-safety and consequence-modelling platform, designed to make advanced industrial safety technology accessible, affordable and scalable while creating the foundation for a comprehensive Indian safety ecosystem. Positioned as the first platform of its kind globally, Agnikawach brings AI, GPU-native computing, adaptive-mesh CFD, cloud delivery and risk modelling together on a single safety platform. Unlike conventional foreign safety software that operates through separate and often expensive tools, Agnikawach is designed to provide a unified workflow covering eight major industrial hazards, including jet fire, pool fire, flash fire, explosions, BLEVE/fireball, toxic dispersion, cryogenic releases and structural domino effects. Advertisement Building India’s Safety Ecosystem AgniKawach is being developed as a globally scalable technology platform—not a conventional consulting product—with applications across Green Hydrogen, ammonia, oil & gas, LNG, offshore/onshore, oil, Natural Gas, petrochemicals, chemicals, Refineries, Fertilizers, bioenergy, energy storage, nuclear, defense, aviation and other hazardous industries. Yet advanced consequence modelling has historically depended heavily on expensive imported software, creating a significant accessibility and strategic-technology gap. Agnikawach aims to address this gap by providing 100% Indian intellectual property, cloud-based access and a significantly more affordable alternative to legacy platforms. Advertisement The platform’s broader vision goes beyond software. Agnikawach seeks to connect industry, MSMEs, universities, researchers, regulators, engineering institutions, emergency-response organisations and insurance and financial institutions through a common safety-technology ecosystem. The accident not an act of God; it is a result of sheer negligence on the part of the management. The consequences of the accident could have been minimized to a significant extent. “Safety should not be a privilege available only to organisations that can afford expensive foreign software. Our vision is to put world-class safety modelling on every engineer’s desk and create an indigenous ecosystem where safety becomes accessible, predictive and preventive,” said Dr. J. P. Gupta, Founder, Agnikawach Safety Solutions Pvt. Ltd. A New Technology Architecture for Process Safety Agnikawach combines GPU-native computing, adaptive mesh refinement, AI-assisted workflows, cloud-first architecture and open validation and verification. Its development roadmap has already reached TRL 5, with a working GPU-native AMR-CFD prototype validated against benchmark cases. Agnikawach is supported by a leadership and technology team with expertise spanning process safety, CFD, hydrogen safety, AI and industrial risk modelling, along with senior leaders and advisors from Govt., PSUs and R&D institutions. From “Safety Software” to “Safety Infrastructure” Agnikawach’s long-term objective is to transform industrial safety from a specialist, high-cost activity into an accessible national capability—helping industries simulate hazards before incidents occur, strengthen emergency preparedness, support regulatory assessments and enable safer deployment of India’s emerging energy technologies. The company believes that India can move from importing safety technology to developing and exporting world-class safety technology, creating a new global opportunity in industrial risk management. articles.title: UST to Host GenCyS 2026 Conference Exploring the Intersection of AI and Security
articles.content: Second annual AI and cybersecurity conference unites technology leaders, researchers and students to explore the future of secure innovation THIRUVANANTHAPURAM, India , Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — UST , a leading AI and technology transformation solutions company, will host the GenCyS 2026 global AI and cybersecurity conference at its Thiruvananthapuram campus from September 5 – 6, 2026. Building on the success of the inaugural event in 2025, the conference will bring together technology leaders, AI practitioners, security experts, researchers, developers, and students to explore the rapidly evolving intersection of artificial intelligence and security. The free hybrid conference will feature lectures, technical sessions, panel discussions, and hands-on workshops centred around the convergence of advanced artificial intelligence and robust security practices. Attendees will learn directly from industry experts, exchange ideas, and explore how AI is transforming cybersecurity. GenCyS 2026 aims to empower participants to innovate safely in an evolving digital landscape, offering insights into emerging AI technologies, evolving security challenges, and the future of secure innovation. The event will also host the GenCyS CTF Finals , bringing together finalists from UST’s capture-the-flag cybersecurity competition that attracted more than 1,500 participants from around the world. With online participation available for those unable to attend in Thiruvananthapuram and free registration for all, GenCyS 2026 welcomes students, professionals, and technology enthusiasts from around the world to experience two days of dynamic learning, meaningful interaction, and exciting discovery. articles.title: URBAN unveils ARC NOTE, India's first AI Meeting Smart Fitness Band
articles.content: New Delhi, Aug 31: URBAN , a homegrown technology brand known for design-led innovation, today announced the launch of URBAN ARC NOTE , India’s First AI Meeting Smart Fitness Band , bringing AI -powered meeting intelligence and 24×7 wellness tracking to a screen-free wearable. Designed to record conversations directly from the wrist and transform them into searchable transcripts, meeting summaries, translations and AI -generated mind maps, ARC NOTE combines productivity and wellness in a single device. Priced at INR 6,999, it will be available from 7th September 2026, with advance bookings opening on 31st August 2026. Consumers who advance book ARC NOTE will receive an additiona lINR 1,000 discount, making it available at an effective price of INR 5,999 during the advance booking period. ARC NOTE will be available through URBAN Online, authorised trade partners, leading e-commerce platforms, online marketplaces and retail outlets across India. The flagship ARC NOTE is designed for professionals, entrepreneurs, students and consumers who spend a significant part of their day in meetings and conversations. By bringing meeting recording and AI -powered productivity capabilities to a screen-free fitness band , URBAN is looking to expand the role of wearables beyond conventional health and activity tracking, while continuing to offer the everyday wellness features expected from a fitness band . Speaking about the launch, Aashish Kumbhat, co-founder, URBAN , said, “Wearables have evolved far beyond simply counting steps. For a long time, advanced health and wellness technology has been associated with premium devices, making it less accessible to everyday consumers. We wanted to change that. With ARC NOTE , we are bringing AI -powered productivity and wellness together in one practical, accessible wearable, whether it is capturing an important conversation, helping users make sense of it or becoming more aware of their health. At URBAN , we believe technology is most valuable when it can make a real difference in everyday life, and ARC NOTE is a step towards putting more intelligent technology on the wrist of more Indians.” ARC NOTE – Bringing AI Meeting Intelligence to the Wrist At the heart of ARC NOTE is its AI Meeting Recorder, which allows users to start recording directly from the band with a simple double click and stop with a single press. The band provides an indication when recording begins, and recording is activated only by the user rather than functioning as an always-listening device. ARC NOTE can support up to approximately 16 hours of recording on a full charge. Once a conversation is recorded, ARC NOTE ‘s AI -powered capabilities help turn it into structured information: AI Transcription: Converts recorded conversations into searchable text, allowing users to revisit specific names, numbers, decisions and discussion points. Live Translation: Translates conversations across supported languages, with support for 17+ Indian languages, helping users understand and revisit multilingual discussions. articles.content: News On AIR | February 17, 2026 9:47 PM Evening News THE HEADLINES : India and France establish Special Global Strategic Partnership after talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Emmanuel Macron in Mumbai; Both countries exchange 21 agreements and documents in key areas of Defence, Energy, and Critical Minerals among others. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and France’s Minister of the Armed Forces and Veterans Affairs, Catherine Vautrin, were present at the site. Mr Modi expressed confidence that these helicopters will be the first aircraft to fly as high as Mt Everest and will be exported worldwide. Prime Minister Modi remarked that the year 2026 is a turning point in Indo-European relations and expressed confidence that the recent Free Trade Agreement between the two entities will accelerate ties between India and France. Later, both the leaders also inaugurated the India-France Innovation Forum in Mumbai.
